gaps.lead: 'I've never been to Asia,' she told me.
gaps.sentence: She told me that ___ to Asia.
gaps.explanation: Present perfect shifts to past perfect: she had never been.

gaps.lead: The train takes two hours to get there; the plane takes thirty minutes.
gaps.explanation: twice as fast as = half the time of.

gaps.lead: 'Don't touch the paintings,' the guard warned us.
gaps.explanation: Negative commands are reported with not + to-infinitive: warned us not to touch.

gaps.lead: She started working here five years ago.
gaps.explanation: Action starting in the past and continuing: has been working (present perfect continuous).

gaps.lead: She prefers reading to watching television.
gaps.explanation: prefer X to Y = would rather do X than do Y.

gaps.lead: The mechanic is servicing my car tomorrow.
gaps.explanation: Arranged service: have/get something done — having my car serviced.
